requirements.text: Knowledge-capture scope (clarifies D-054): anything discovered during any work that is useful for later parts of the program - not only loop mechanics - is appended to the shared knowledge stores when discovered (.claude/rules/PROGRAM_KNOWLEDGE.md for program-wide pointers within budget, docs/WORKING_KNOWLEDGE.md for current-section detail).
requirements.required_harness: Knowledge stores gain entries as discoveries happen, not at session end.
requirements.required_evidence: git history of the knowledge stores

requirements.text: Create a terse coding-rules file (.claude/rules/CODING_RULES.md, auto-injected): very few words, plain do/don't lines only, covering coding and file-preparation rules derived from error classes actually hit that could recur as CI failures. Seeded from real defect arcs (strict-TS casts in web tests, focus-after-remount, empty test placeholders, thin-client npm prohibition, ruff-first for api, jsdom canvas noise masking, out-of-scope consumer sweeps, LF-normalized digests). No prose, no history, no duplication of PROGRAM_KNOWLEDGE control-plane content; stays inside the D-067 10000-token eager budget.
requirements.required_harness: File exists, terse do/don't form, context_budget_check passes.
requirements.required_evidence: the file + passing budget check output

requirements.text: Maintenance: when a new coding/file-preparation error class is hit that could recur as a CI failure, append one terse do/don't line to CODING_RULES.md at discovery time; compress or demote before adding if the eager budget would be exceeded; never let the file grow prose.
requirements.required_harness: New defect classes appear as new lines in later commits.
